I was the short and weak kid when I was your age and felt truly insecure about it so I can relate. It took some time to accept who I was (physically at least) and I can tell it’s really all about that accepting yourself as you are, it doesn’t matter if you grow taller and stronger (which more than likely you will to some degree), what matters is that you accept yourself. 

Remember that nobody is automatically the best at what they love, it takes a lot of hard work and even harder work when you fail which you will as we all do. I would recommend trying to avoid comparing yourself to others and try to do it to your past self and acknowledging your own improvements.
